yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā

62092.meaning1: one's school; one's teacher's doctrine; traditional teaching

examples.text: siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, ye no dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tesu patiṭṭhāpetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. akusalā c'eva vo te dhammā hontu akusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.

62097.meaning1: mode of living; lifestyle; way of life
62097.commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti.

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

62098.meaning1: undertaken the lifestyle; engaged in the way of life (of)
62098.commentary: (VIN 1.1.1) sājīvaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sājīvaṃ nāma. tasmiṃ sikkhati, tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti. (VINa) tena vuccati sājīvasamāpanno'ti idam'pi anantarassa sājīvapadass'eva vasena vuttaṃ. yasmā pana so sikkham'pi samāpanno, tasmā sikkhāsamāpanno'ti'pi atthato veditabbo. evañ'hi sati sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno'ti etassa padassa padabhājanam'pi paripuṇṇaṃ hoti.
